title: Busy Mother Hen
summary: Mother Hen sits patiently on her eggs, waiting for them to hatch. How long will it take? And will she miss the fair?
pages: Mother Hen sits on her eggs. She waits and waits for the eggs to hatch.
Mother Goat walks by. "Will you come with me to the fair?" she asks Mother Hen. "I'm busy with my eggs," answers Mother Hen.
One, two, three, four, five, six. Six round eggs!
Mother Pig walks by. "Will you come with me to the fair?" she asks. "I'm busy with my eggs," answers Mother Hen.
One, two, three, four, five, six. Six round eggs!
Mother Cow walks by. "Will you come with me to the fair?" she asks Mother Hen.
"I'm busy with my eggs," answers Mother Hen.
Mother Hen waits and waits. "When will I see my chicks?" she wonders.
Mother Hen feels something. What's happening?
One, two, three, four, five, six. Crack! Crack! Crack! Crack! Crack! Crack!
Mother Hen is happy with her lovely chicks.
And then she remembers. Today is the fair! Mother Goat, Mother Pig and Mother Cow have already gone. Now Mother Hen is ready. She will take her chicks to the fair. One, two, three, four, five, six!
Mother Hen and her six chicks have a wonderful time at the fair. What fun! Her chicks were worth the wait.
